items.title: Virginia Mayhew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2022
items.q: She has performed with Diva, Al Grey, and Claudio Roditi

ctx.x: Virginia Mayhew has led a diverse career as a saxophonist, composer, and band leader. She has performed with Diva, Al Grey, and Claudio Roditi, and has recorded extensively as a leader and proponent of her own jazz compositions.
Virginia was interviewed via Zoom on May 23, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
